_comment: Metalstorm native JS UI manifest (PLAN-native-ui.md §3). Widgets receive a ui-store read API, a DOM mount inside #ui-root, and the validated command/directive submission API. Panel CHROME (frame, header, collapse toggle, count badge) is built by the loader from the `title`/`collapsible`/`collapsed` fields below — widgets render content only, so every panel looks the same by construction.
_layout: Docking keeps the centre and lower-centre of the viewport clear for unit selection and orders: authority pill top-left; the two heavy negotiation/AI panels in the left rail (collapsed by default); objectives + scoreboard in the right rail; the command composer as a compact bar above the bottom help strip. Rails are fixed-width and scroll internally rather than stretching full-height. Bottom-left and bottom-right belong to the engine HUD (selection readout, minimap).

widgets._chrome: No title — the pill renders its own compact frame; a header would double its height for no extra information.

widgets.title: Parley
widgets._chrome: Collapsed by default and badged with the incoming-proposal count — diplomacy is episodic, so the panel should announce itself rather than occupy the rail permanently.

widgets.title: AI Command
widgets._chrome: The tallest panel in the HUD (stance, ROE, region paint, asset locks, funding, intent, change feed) — set-and-forget, so it starts collapsed.

widgets._builtin_note: Mounted from the client bundle (client/src/native-widgets/command-composer.js) via BUILTIN_WIDGETS, not fetched from this dir — it depends on bundled compile-table + named-entity-index modules. The game-dir command-composer.js is a stub kept for reference.
widgets.title: Compose Command
